title: Agent skill orders the cheapest McDonald's China meal and splits group bills per person
summary: Coupons, spend thresholds and shared delivery fees make McDonald's China orders hard to optimise. This skill has an agent compare coupon combinations with real price calls, collect a group's orders and produce a per-person bill, asking for approval before any order is placed.
agent_role: The agent finds stores, gathers coupons, lists candidate combinations, calls calculate-price for each and builds group bills, and it can push daily campaign alerts. The user must explicitly confirm every order, coupon claim or other write action.
outcome: The author's example shows a ¥41 order reduced to ¥33 by the cheapest coupon option. The author also reports that a 2026-10-13 test missed a collab campaign until '联动' was added as a synonym.

curation.rationale: Reviewed: near-duplicate of the published McDonald's China coupon-optimizer skill from the same contest; the stronger entry was kept.
